lines.japanese: 「ふぁ～あふ」
lines.english: “Yaaawn.”

lines.japanese: 眠みぃ……。
lines.english: I'm sleepy...

lines.japanese: ん、つうか、なんでコタツで寝てンだっけ俺。
lines.english: Wait, why am I sleeping under the kotatsu?

lines.japanese: ああ、そっか。
lines.english: Oh, right.

lines.japanese: 仮統合にほころびが出て、なんやかんやあったんだっけ。
lines.english: The provisional integration had started coming apart, and then some stuff happened.

lines.japanese: かァー、くっそ、ワケ分かんね。
lines.english: Goddamn it. I don't understand any of this.

lines.japanese: 俺は半身を起こして、後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I pushed my upper body upright and scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、焼けた！　羽田さん、スポンジ焼けたみたいだよ！」
lines.english: “Oh! It's done! Haneda, I think the sponge cake is baked!”

lines.japanese: 「わっ、上出来かも。今ちょっと食べてみたいね」
lines.english: “Wow, it might have come out perfect. I kind of want to taste it now.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー」
lines.english: “Me too.”

lines.japanese: 「でもアリスちゃんに悪いから我慢しようねー」
lines.english: “But that wouldn't be fair to Alice, so let's wait.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 台所からは小鳩と吉田（だっけ？　名前忘れた）のじゃれ合う声が聞こえる。
lines.english: From the kitchen came the playful voices of Kobato and Yoshida—or whatever her name was. I'd forgotten.

lines.japanese: あーあー、若い方々は平和で何よりですねえ。
lines.english: Well, well. How nice that the young people were at peace.

lines.japanese: 手持無沙汰でなんとなくテレビのリモコンを押した。
lines.english: With nothing to do, I idly pressed a button on the television remote.

lines.japanese: 画面がどっかの国のモノクロ映画に切りかわる。まぶしそうな眼をしたトレンチコートの刑事が、バーのスツールにケツを下ろすところだった。
lines.english: The screen changed to a black-and-white movie from some country. A detective in a trench coat with squinting eyes was lowering his ass onto a barstool.

lines.japanese: お、いいじゃんコレ。古き良きハードボイルド。煙草の吸い方が渋いねえ、おっさん。
lines.english: Hey, this was good. Classic, old-school hard-boiled. Nice way of smoking that cigarette, old man.

lines.japanese: 『マスター、グラン・マルニエ・コスモポリタンを彼女に』
lines.english: “Bartender, a Grand Marnier Cosmopolitan for the lady.”

lines.japanese: おっさんはニヒルに笑った。
lines.english: The old man smiled cynically.

lines.japanese: 「マスター、グランマ・ルニエ・コスモポリタンを彼女に」
lines.english: “Bartender, a Grandma Lunier Cosmopolitan for the lady.”

lines.japanese: 俺もニヒルに笑った。
lines.english: I smiled cynically too.

lines.japanese: ひゅっ。カウンターテーブルの上をカクテルグラスが滑ってゆく。
lines.english: Whoosh. A cocktail glass slid down the bar.

lines.japanese: ひゅっ。俺もコタツの上で湯呑を滑らせた。
lines.english: Whoosh. I slid a teacup across the kotatsu.

lines.japanese: 「わ、わわっ！」
lines.english: “W-whoa!”

lines.japanese: 力の加減に失敗して湯呑は庭先までブッ飛んでゆく勢いだったが、たまたまそこに通りかかった吉田の手によって難を逃れた。
lines.english: I misjudged my strength, and the cup nearly went flying all the way into the yard. Fortunately, Yoshida happened to be passing and caught it.

lines.japanese: 「やるよ。俺のおごりだ」
lines.english: “It's yours. My treat.”

lines.japanese: うおお危なかったあサンキューウ、と叫ぶのは胸の内だけ。俺はあくまでハードボイルドを貫いた。
lines.english: I screamed “Whoa, that was close! Thank you!” only in my heart. Outwardly, I remained hard-boiled to the end.

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、あああ、ありがとうございます、ありがたくいただきます」
lines.english: “Y-yes! Th-th-thank you very much. I’ll gladly have some.”

lines.japanese: 「よせよ。そんな言葉が聞きたかったわけじゃない」
lines.english: “Don't. Those aren't the words I wanted to hear.”

lines.japanese: ぺたんと座って誰かの飲み残しをすする女へ、俺は目潰しピースを送った。
lines.english: I flashed an eye-stabbing peace sign at the girl as she sat down and sipped somebody else’s leftover tea.

lines.japanese: やべえ。またひとり、女を目で殺してしまった。
lines.english: Damn. I'd killed another woman with my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「え？　あ、あれれっ……？」
lines.english: “What? W-wait...?”

lines.japanese: 吉田に続いて、小鳩も台所から出てきた。ハードボイルドに空想煙草をくゆらせている俺を見て、目を丸くする。すぐ気付くよな、うちのお姫さまは。
lines.english: Kobato emerged from the kitchen after Yoshida. Her eyes widened when she saw me smoking an imaginary cigarette in hard-boiled fashion. Our little princess always noticed right away.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえその、えと……ですか？」
lines.english: “Oh, um... Is that...?”

lines.japanese: 「です」
lines.english: “It is.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そなんだ……」
lines.english: “Oh. I see...”

lines.japanese: ぺたん。やつも座った。
lines.english: Plop. She sat down too.

lines.japanese: がしがし。俺は後ろ頭を掻いた。
lines.english: Scratch, scratch. I clawed at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: おっさんの英語以外、部屋は無音だった。
lines.english: Apart from the old man's English, the room was silent.

lines.japanese: たまに吉田が茶をすする音だけが挿入された。
lines.english: Occasionally, the sound of Yoshida sipping her tea cut in.

lines.japanese: なにこの空気。いいけどべつに。
lines.english: What the hell was this mood? Not that I cared.

lines.japanese: 「……あんさ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、はいっ」
lines.english: “Y-yes!”

lines.japanese: なぜか背筋を伸ばす小鳩。
lines.english: For some reason, Kobato straightened her back.

lines.japanese: 「もうその……なんだ。あのアレ、ケーキ的なモンとか作んなくていいの」
lines.english: “Shouldn't you be... you know. Making that cake thing or whatever?”

lines.japanese: 「は、はいっ、スポンジが焼けたので、あとは材料まつっ、待ちです」
lines.english: “Y-yes! The sponge cake is baked, so now we're waiting for the ingredients.”

lines.japanese: 噛むな。つうかビビんな。ちょっぴりショックじゃねえか、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。
lines.english: Don't stumble over your words. And quit being scared. It kinda hurts my feelings. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.

lines.japanese: しばらく妙な空気の中でテレビを眺めていると、とつぜん電話が鳴った。
lines.english: We watched television in that peculiar atmosphere for a while. Then the phone abruptly rang.

lines.japanese: 小鳩が立ちあがりかけたが、俺は兄貴らしく片手で制して、代わりに取りに向かった。
lines.english: Kobato started to stand, but I stopped her with one hand in big-brotherly fashion and went to answer it myself.

lines.japanese: 俺にもちょっとぐらい≪存在意義≫ってやつを果たさせろプリンセス。
lines.english: Let me fulfill a little of my *reason for being* too, Princess.

lines.japanese: 「はい、成田工務店。じゃねえや。えーと羽田」
lines.english: “Hello, Narita Construction. Wait, no. Uh, Haneda residence.”

lines.japanese: 『ドラ、私だ』
lines.english: “Dora. It is me.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、アリスか」
lines.english: “Oh, Alice.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、アリスちゃん？」
lines.english: “Is that Alice?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩がこちらを見た。俺は小さく頷いた。
lines.english: Kobato looked over. I gave her a small nod.

lines.japanese: 『ドラ、また大変なことが起こりました』
lines.english: “Dora, another serious thing has occurred.”

lines.japanese: 「あん？　なに、尿道から変な膿みでも出たの」
lines.english: “Huh? What, you got some weird pus coming out of your urethra?”

lines.japanese: 『いいえ、おまえとは違う。私は忘れてしまったのです、買われるべき酒の名前』
lines.english: “No. I am not like you. I have forgotten the name of the alcohol that should be bought.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？　酒？」
lines.english: “What? Alcohol?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、アリスちゃんには、ケーキに使う用のお酒を頼んだんです」
lines.english: “We asked Alice to buy some alcohol for the cake.”

lines.japanese: 俺のしかめ面を見て、小鳩が注釈を添えた。
lines.english: Kobato added the explanation when she saw my scowl.

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。でもこいつ、いま商品名忘れて買えないっつってるぞ」
lines.english: “Huh. Well, she says she forgot the product name, so she can't buy it.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 『日本ではよくあることだ』
lines.english: “This is a thing that often happens in Japan.”

lines.japanese: 「日本ではよくあることだって」
lines.english: “She says it happens all the time in Japan.”

lines.japanese: 「えー！　ないよう、そんなの」
lines.english: “What?! No, it doesn't!”

lines.japanese: 『だがその名前はコバト、またはアキラが覚えているはずだ』
lines.english: “But Kobato or Akira should remember the name.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえらが覚えてるはずだって」
lines.english: “She says one of you should remember it.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　うそ、吉川さん覚えてる？　私、もう忘れちゃったよ」
lines.english: “What? Oh, no. Do you remember, Yoshikawa? I've already forgotten.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　私なんか、そもそも最初から聞きながしてたよ？」
lines.english: “What? I wasn't even listening closely in the first place.”

lines.japanese: 駄目じゃん。三人とも駄目じゃん。
lines.english: Useless. All three of them were useless.

lines.japanese: 「んー、やっぱり日本ではよくあることなのかも」
lines.english: “Hmm. Maybe it really does happen all the time in Japan.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、きっとそうだよ。よくあるんだよ、えへへ」
lines.english: “Yeah, it must. It happens all the time. Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: えへへ？　いまのどこが笑わせポイントだ？　すげえな。こいつら大物だ。
lines.english: Hee-hee? What part of that was the punch line? Incredible. These girls were unshakable.

lines.japanese: 俺は首をひねって小鳩に訊いた。
lines.english: I cocked my head and asked Kobato a question.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。酒ってどうしても必要なの」
lines.english: “Hey. Do you absolutely need the alcohol?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええっと、その、出来れば欲しかったんですけど、あの、へーきです、なくてもししょうはないです。たぶん」
lines.english: “What? Um, we'd like to have it if possible, but it's okay. We can make do without it. Probably.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり、あった方がいいのな。もしもし、おいアリス」
lines.english: “So it'd be better to have it. Hello? Hey, Alice.”

lines.japanese: 『なんだ。私の名は貴様ごときに気安く呼ばれるべきではない』
lines.english: “What is it? My name is not to be used so casually by the likes of you.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。いいから、なあ、なんか料理に使える酒、カンでいいから適当に買ってこい。ないよりマシだろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Listen, just buy some alcohol that looks usable for cooking. Guess if you have to. Anything's better than nothing.”

lines.japanese: 『私は困る、そんな適当では。適当なのはあなたの人生だけで十分だ』
lines.english: “This troubles me. Your life is haphazard enough already.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえっつんだよ。あー、じゃーアレだ。あのー、なんつったっけ」
lines.english: “I said shut up. Fine, then get that stuff. Uh, what was it called?”

lines.japanese: さっき映画で渋いおっさんが言ってたアレ。
lines.english: The thing the cool old man in the movie had said.

lines.japanese: 「グ、グ……グランマ、ルニエ……？　ああ、そうだ、たぶんそんなような名前の酒があると思うから、ソレでいい。ソレ買ってこい」
lines.english: “Gr-Grandma Lunier...? Yeah, that's it. I think there's some alcohol with a name like that. Get that. Buy it.”

lines.japanese: 『承知した。だが、あなたの人生が適当であることに変わりはないだろう』
lines.english: “Understood. But your life remains as haphazard as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえっつってんだろテメ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I told you to shut the fuck up! I'll kill you, asshole!”

lines.japanese: “汝の敵を裁け”
lines.english: “Pass judgment upon thine enemy.”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 力強く電話を切った瞬間、声が聞こえた。内側からの声だ。
lines.english: The instant I slammed down the phone, I heard a voice. A voice from inside me.

lines.japanese: “爆ぜろ、ファルコン。そして良き風を起こすのだ”
lines.english: “Burst forth, Falcon, and summon a worthy wind.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえかよ……」
lines.english: “You again...”

lines.japanese: 俺はげんなりした。
lines.english: I sagged in disgust.

lines.japanese: 「来んな。出てくんな。敵なんかいねーから。ぜんぜん怒ってねーから」
lines.english: “Stay away. Don't come out. There is no enemy. I'm not angry at all.”

lines.japanese: “そうだ、貴様には無理だ。あとは俺に任せろ。さあ、去ね。去んで玉座を余に空けよ”
lines.english: “Indeed. The task lies beyond you. Leave the rest to me. Now begone. Begone, and yield the throne to your king.”

lines.japanese: 「うーわ、うっぜぇ……」
lines.english: “God, you're annoying...”

lines.japanese: ヤロウもだいぶ丸くなったとはいえ、いまこの不安定な状態のときにシャシャられるのは困る。一度でも油断したら未来永劫≪コックピット≫を独占されかねない。
lines.english: The bastard had mellowed considerably, but I couldn't afford to let him push forward while we were unstable. Relax for even one moment, and he might monopolize the *Cockpit* for all eternity.

lines.japanese: くそっ……かと言って俺ひとりで粘るには限界がある。
lines.english: Shit... But there was a limit to how long I could hold out alone.

lines.japanese: 認めたくはないが、こと王座の争奪に関していえば、やつの力は強大だ。おそらくヨージに次ぐほどの──
lines.english: I hated to admit it, but when it came to struggling for the throne, his power was immense. Probably second only to Youji's—

lines.japanese: ──ヨージ！
lines.english: —Youji!

lines.japanese: そうか、あのガキならやつを抑えられる。例のでたらめなお兄ちゃんパワーとやらで。
lines.english: Of course. That kid could hold him back with his ridiculous “big brother power.”

lines.japanese: 「よし」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 俺は居間へ戻り、そのまま横になって目を閉じた。
lines.english: I returned to the living room, lay down, and closed my eyes.

lines.japanese: 来い、長男坊。
lines.english: Come forth, eldest brother.
